description: agent.import reads a card file from a path and returns the imported agent with its idempotency result — created, updated, or no-op (AM3, the (slug, version) result a third-party client must be able to render). It is a daemon write the CLI and the app share (P34); unsigned import is refused by default (AM3) unless the operator's override is set, and a package arrives as a filesystem path, never a scheme.
